PLDMDeviceInventory.description: Downstream Exposes type. Declares the RoT chassis to entity-manager and optionally names a pre-existing inventory object where pldmd should also write the device UUID. On encountering this entry, entity-manager creates the object at CreateInventoryPath with Inventory.Item.Board/Platform plus the static properties below; pldmd writes only the dynamic UUID.

Name.description: A recognisable name for the PLDMDeviceInventory entry.

MCTPTargetName.description: Match key tying this entry to the transport anchor's Name.

CreateInventoryPath.description: Absolute D-Bus path entity-manager creates for this device's RoT chassis. pldmd writes UUID here after creation.

UpdateInventoryPath.description: Absolute D-Bus path of an already-existing inventory object (created by some other entity-manager entity). pldmd writes the same UUID here in addition to CreateInventoryPath. entity-manager does NOT create this object.

Manufacturer.description: Written by entity-manager to Decorator.Asset.Manufacturer on the created chassis.

Associations.description: Written by entity-manager to Association.Definitions on the created chassis.

^xyz\\.openbmc_project\\..description: Any xyz.openbmc_project.* decorator key (e.g. Inventory.Item.SPDMResponder) is applied by entity-manager to the created chassis object.

title: PLDM Device Inventory Exposes Record
description: Downstream entity-manager Exposes schema declaring a RoT chassis entity-manager creates for a PLDM device, plus an optional pre-existing inventory object pldmd also writes the UUID to.
